_about: The public build log. Newest first. One plain line per thing that shipped, written for a stranger. Claude adds a line whenever a session logs a ship in the vault. Never name the nonprofit client or anything private. Josef never edits this file.

entries.line: The kids' cooking app got its new logo, everywhere in the app.
Build 2 of the kids' cooking app, checked screen by screen on a real phone.
Deepcuts got its new look, built and walked through on iPhone.
Bird League build 50 runs on Apple's newest tools.
Deepcuts build 4 works end to end on iPhone.
All 15 songs on the album are written. Production started.
Bird League build 49: the map crash fixed, new stats cards, sharper art.
The first Deepcuts build went up to TestFlight, Apple's testing app.
Every word on dragomansjourney.com rechecked: if it isn't there for a reader, it's gone.
The program's real recipes went live in the kids' cooking app, with printing.
Bird League's sound ID now runs on its own, and newcomers get a trophy ceremony.
Duel medals went live in Bird League.
Bird League players can now send their sightings to eBird in one tap.
The Deepcuts iPhone app was built overnight.
Bird League got The Almanac and a trophy ceremony.
Step-by-step videos and a full Spanish version went into the kids' cooking app.
The kids' cooking app runs on Android as well as iPhone and iPad.
